sources.title: British Isles modern DSM and land-cover reference
sources.publisher: Copernicus / ESA / Airbus; ESA WorldCover consortium; Natural Earth

access_metadata.dem_type: DSM, includes vegetation/infrastructure; not bare-earth DTM
access_metadata.cover_epoch: 2021, WorldCover v200 classes 10/20/30/40/60/90; no specific heather or peat classification
access_metadata.sampling: Native GLO90 3 arcseconds latitude, variable longitude. 6-arcsecond averaged research extraction; 1/512-degree display. Cover from 16x categorical overview, class colours area-averaged in linear space.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern geographic reference only. No 1900 cover, ownership, yield, forestry or military effect.
access_metadata.footprint: Only physical island components from existing R27 Natural Earth land, with sea-side material sampling collar. Not political borders.
